Looking for an NDT school near Tampa? How Level III preparation works from here

Atlantis has no classroom in Tampa, and you do not need one to prepare for Level III. The course runs nationally as self-paced online theory on the ASNT NDT Level III training page, and ASNT sets and runs the examinations. Candidates in Tampa enroll online, study around their shifts and apply to ASNT for the Basic and Method examinations once they qualify.

Who needs a Level III around Tampa Bay. A Level III approves procedures, writes or reviews the employer's written practice, and examines Level I and II staff. Around the bay, four groups need that work done:

  • the ship repair yards at Hookers Point, on the Ybor Channel and at Port Hendry, which examine hull, piping and pressure-part welds;
  • the operators of the fuel terminals that take in nearly half of Florida's petroleum supply, who need tank and piping NDE programs;
  • Tampa Electric, which repowered its Big Bend station as a combined-cycle plant with heat recovery steam generators;
  • Mosaic's Riverview fertilizer plant, which runs sulfuric and phosphoric acid units.

Inspection companies that serve these owners also need a Level III to keep their written practice, procedures and certification records in order. That role is often the bottleneck when a contractor wants to add a method.

Radiation safety is a separate qualification. A Level III certificate in radiography does not make the holder a radiation safety officer. The Florida Department of Health's guide to industrial radiography licensing requires the RSO to have at least one year of documented experience as a radiographer and 16 hours of formal instruction in running a radiation safety program. It also requires radiographers to be trained, tested and certified, with their job performance audited at least every six months. An employer building radiography capability in Florida has to fill both roles. The Level III owns the technique and the written practice, and the RSO owns the license conditions.

If you searched for an NDT school near Tampa. Most people who search that way need Level I or Level II, not Level III. For those levels, see NDT training in Tampa, the Level I and Level II courses, and Practical NDT for Tampa, where you can practice scans on a 3D simulator. Under SNT-TC-1A, a course provides the formal training hours. The employer documents your experience, and through its Level III, examines and certifies you against its written practice.

Course costs and timing. This page does not list course costs. The course portal shows the cost in your local currency at checkout, and employer groups get a quote. ASNT's published experience routes set the timing, not the course. The qualifying experience has to be in place before you can sit the Level III examinations, so you can start the theory while you are still building that experience as a Level II.

Employers that need a Level III now. Some employers need a Level III on call more than a new certificate. Outsourced ASNT NDT Level III consulting covers procedures, written practice, audits and subcontractor approval. SNT-TC-1A program set-up builds a written practice from scratch, and NDT consulting in Tampa is the local page. Ask about Level III preparation from Tampa, saying which methods you hold and how much documented experience you have.
